correctness.rationale: The identity W=(sum x)(sum y)-sum xy follows exactly from distinct ordered endpoints. Its type coefficients and binomial multiplicities are proved by counting; the modulo-four obstruction is exact for all odd n; feasible witness sign patterns exhibit all zero/nonzero extrema for every n >= 2. Exhaustive direct enumeration through n=8 and independent overlap enumeration through n=30 passed, corroborating rather than replacing the all-order argument.
